message.content: The reopened debate round focuses on claim c3 (FP16-extreme magnitudes). I'll record a targeted description update that sharpens what that claim needs: the precise worst-case probe conditions, the analytic margin analysis for the FP64-internal/FP32-output path, and which extreme patterns are worth testing (note that a uniform ±65504 row has zero non-DC energy, while alternating ±65504 concentrates all energy in the Nyquist bin — so mixed random sign patterns at full FP16 magnitude are the ones that stress many bins at once).
